HEALTHY FOOD & EATING WELL · CLASS 40 · AGES 4–5

Feel Full

The feel full card from Class 40 · Healthy Food & Eating Well — one happy habit, said by YOU, tried tonight.

The card’s habit

“Full is a good feeling to notice” — the feel full card’s big words, in the child’s voice.

Try it tonight

the belly check — halfway through the meal say how your tummy feels and practise noticing the difference between still-hungry and comfortably full.

Keep going

This page is one of twenty-one cards in Class 40 · Healthy Food & Eating Well — the whole plate, the meals shelf and the table habits are one click away. For more foods to name, the Cafeteria room keeps sixty-two food cards with activities of their own.
